maker: Codex lead using the existing continuity-check candidate and Canon Guardian instructions
scope: Two-chapter source-derived internal continuity proposal; not a release selection

edits.before: On the fourth day, Maret showed up at the lighthouse door before dawn
edits.after: On the third day, Maret showed up at the lighthouse door before dawn
edits.reason: The visitors arrive the next morning. Moving this visit one day earlier reconciles their day-four arrival with chapter two's repeated four-days-ago statements; the warning, fish and goodbye remain.

edits.before: The first arrived at dawn. The second at midday. The third was already there when Kael turned around.
edits.after: The first arrived at dawn. The second later that morning. The third was already there when Kael turned around.
edits.reason: The later narration places Bren's arrival as the sun clears the sea-cliffs and the subsequent conversations in the morning. Change the opening summary rather than moving every later event.

edits.before: There was something about the directness that was restful after two days of people with agendas wrapped in care.
edits.after: There was something about the directness that was restful after a morning of people with agendas wrapped in care.
edits.reason: Sirvaine and Bren have just made their offers on the same morning; this local repair keeps the contrast without implying two days of emissary meetings.
All three were missing overnight; one was recovered in the morning and two never were. Preserve the 26/23/3 outcome while avoiding an implication that all three were found.

controls: Six open Gates and Master rank agree with locked canon; preserve Sirvaine's introduction.
Five elemental manifestations do not establish five named Gates or a Luminor rank; add no rank promotion.
Eight hundred years since First Siege and twelve hundred years of sealing are not explicitly the same event; no automatic numerical retcon.
Heart table and historical approval log disagree. Neither chapter depends on a numerical Heart frequency; leave that owner decision unresolved.
Bren's explanation of Malachar's fall and Sela's bloodline claim are character testimony, not locked canon updates.

iterations.status: Initial lead proposal created without seeing baseline response; private source retained.
After seeing baseline, add supported casualty-wording repair. Unblinded refinement, not independent configuration uplift.
